_about: THE FACTS OF THE SUPPORT PAGE (/support). `open` is the one switch: false keeps the page held (unlinked, noindex, no gift can start); true publishes it. Turn it only after the Stripe key is set in Vercel. recipientLine and taxLine are James's answers of 2026-11-21 ("gifts go to me personally") and 2026-11-25 (gifts still come to him; all beyond the costs goes to planting churches through the Ends Initiative and Gather Church). docs/work/elite/giving.md has the steps.
recipientLine: Gifts go to James Bell personally. They pay what LiveWell costs to run, and whatever is left goes to planting churches around the world through the Ends Initiative and Gather Church.
